msgMainDropLabel: Drop audio files to add them
msgMainListEmpty: No files yet. Drag audio files onto this window.
msgStgAboutDesc: is a yaiol Rust app template.
msgMainNoFfmpeg: ffmpeg is not installed, so nothing can be converted. Open Settings to download it.
msgDstPatternHint: Click a tag to add it. A slash makes a sub-folder.
msgDstSourceFixed: This entry always writes next to the original file and keeps its name.
msgPrsRingtoneLimit: An iPhone ringtone is cut to 40 seconds, the longest iOS accepts.
lblDstKeepStructure: Keep the folder structure when converting a folder
msgPrsId3Hint: 2.3 is read by every player and is what Mp3tag writes by default. 2.4 is the newer version and stores text as UTF-8. Both keep a repeated field as separate values.
lblStgNotify: Show notification when conversion is finished
msgClnRemoveTagsHint: One name per line (or separated by ;), as your tag editor shows it (COMMENT, ENCODERSETTINGS, LYRICS). Known names are suggested as you type; click one to use it. A * matches any text: REPLAYGAIN_*. Names are not case sensitive.
tipMainApply: Apply these choices to the selected files
msgMngReorderHint: Drag an entry to change the order. The same order is used in the lists of the window.
tipMainParallel: Files converted at the same time
tipMainDestination: Where the converted files are written
tipMainOverwrite: What to do when the output file already exists
msgCliNoInput: Give at least one file or folder to convert, or use --list to see the saved choices. Run with --help for the options.
msgCliNoAudio: No audio files were found in the given paths.
msgCliUnknown: No saved entry called "{name}" for {flag}. Saved: {list}. Use --list to see them.
lblClnEmbedLrc: Embed the .lrc file as the lyrics
msgClnEmbedLrcHint: If a .lrc file with the same name sits beside the source file, its text becomes the lyrics of the new file and replaces any lyrics the source already has.
lblClnLyricsAuto: Automatic (timed lyrics as SYLT, plain as USLT)
lblClnLyricsStrip: Remove the times when writing USLT
msgClnLyricsHint: Timed lyrics are lines that start with a time such as [01:23.45]. SYLT is the standard frame for timed lyrics, USLT for plain text. Automatic reads the text and writes one of them. With "Always USLT" the timed text is kept as it is, unless you remove the times. These choices apply to ID3 tags (MP3, AIFF, WAV); the other formats keep the lyrics text in their own field.
msgDstRelativeHint: A relative folder such as convert, .\convert or ..\convert is counted from the folder of each file. The folder structure is not kept then.
msgStgFfmpegCheckFailed: Could not reach yaiol to check for the latest version.
msgStgFfmpegExplain: Downloads ffmpeg {version} (about {size} MB) from {source} and installs it for all yaiol apps.
msgCliNoFfmpeg: ffmpeg is not installed yet. Open Audio Converter once: it installs ffmpeg by itself.
tipFxDrag: Drag to change when this effect runs
msgFxNoCatalogue: The effects come with ffmpeg and are not installed yet. They are fetched together with ffmpeg when the app starts online.
